test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Four letter-clusters have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the one that is different.

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter cluster)

1) FGNOP

2) IJQRS

3) OPWXY

4) RSXYZ
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) IJQRS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6c1eec74d55738ad6e64d3598bf8fc94f4dc54000b47eabadca3c5737af81641.png] 

Option 2) FGNOP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7d80219085b41125c3aea94aaf12476a87c31ac70df9a41ca0af4590cd288c0c.png] 

Option 3) RSXYZ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f39a415051ec7ca67f45aabb88e1b0fee69d21223b0cdb31cb3d6d5b15354351.png] 

Option 4) OPWXY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/abe6c2dd315f72f4c35d73b7e2ce54552cd7bab4d2b35f3a189c85db7cb527fa.png] 

Thus, out of all the options "RSXYZ" is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
